checks_run.procedure: Review BE-Z4's diff (sensitive-reach.ts params, list filters, deep-links restrictedLinkChildren, work items, My Work, inbox, create refusals). Try every list, item, search, export, inbox, My Work, lineage and audit path that names a corrective case, transition decision or performance-area link. Judge the action-row/meeting/control residual and the other D-211 questions.
checks_run.command: git diff 95f9819..654e39d -- apps/api/src docs/api; source reading (grep of every read of corrective_case, transition_decision, performance_area_link); sensitive-reach-registers.test.ts in CS-07/CS-08; probes 40-42
checks_run.expected: a restricted case, decision or link is absent from lists, 404 by item and write, redacted in the inbox and My Work, 403 on the deep link, redacted in audit; residuals judged
checks_run.actual: BE-Z4 is correct for the records it names. The reach guard covers every route with correctiveCaseId, transitionDecisionId, performanceAreaLinkId or benefitEnablerId (item, close, signals, actions, PATCH, submit, link remove, enabler remove), reads and writes. The three lists filter after pagination with no hidden count. Creates naming a restricted benefit answer 422 validation.reference, like an unknown id. Work items, My Work and the inbox keep ids with inbox.restricted. The deep link answers 403 deep_link.forbidden. Audit events of the three types are redacted, because they have been in SENSITIVE_CHILD_SOURCES since BE-Y1. Search and assistant retrieval do not index these types (SEARCH_RECORD_TYPES). sensitive-reach-registers.test.ts (5 tests) passes in both locales. Residual judged acceptable under ADR-0051: action rows (raid/actions.ts:426-442 linkCodeOf; the action register report shows source kind only), meeting actions and controls (controls.ts:280-292) carry a restricted case's id or code but none of its values. ADR-0051 §3 treats ids as non-content, the code is a counter (CA-nnn), and the action's own title is the action's content, not the benefit's. Observation, not a finding: an executive ask or blocker status (governance/blocker-escalation.ts:52-63, escalations.ts:398) accepts a restricted corrective case id without the reach check, so a caller who knows the UUID learns that it exists (201 versus 422). That needs the UUID and discloses no content. While sweeping these paths I found that the parent benefit itself leaks through other transformation-level views: F-DG6-300 (CS-10).

The web only localizes the 400 field errors the API already returns to the caller who submitted the SecretRef (an ADM_TECH or connector configurator, who must hold the write permission first), placing each on its row. It adds no request and no information. The API's not_bound versus host_not_bound tells such a caller only whether a name IT bound fits this setting's host; a binding is configuration, not a secret, and no value is ever returned. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or raw server text: the last error is catalogue text or the code, and lastErrorMessage is no longer shown. The problems-all gap is real: F-DG6-301 (Low). Field-error codes inside problems.validation([...]) arrays are not collected, and 3 of 21 such codes have no en/ar text: validation.commit_on_behalf_of, validation.credential_refs, validation.unknown_version. checks_run.procedure: Judge the D-209 credential-less egress residual and the ADR-0011 object-store omission on this candidate.
checks_run.command: git diff 95f9819..654e39d (no change to connectors, storage, notification channels or the assistant's endpoint handling); reading docs/operations/restricted-network.md and ADR-0011
checks_run.expected: judgements recorded
checks_run.actual: Unchanged since round 3, so my round-3 judgements stand. Credential-less endpoints (an http_pull without credential, an SMTP relay without AUTH, an assistant endpoint) can still reach internal hosts. This is an acceptable residual. Only an ADM_TECH can configure one. http_pull is https-only, refuses redirects, caps the body and parses a strict envelope. No secret can be carried there (the D-209 binding). D-209 and ADR-0052 leave the rest to the egress policy that restricted-network.md tells IT to configure, and that document lists the S3-compatible object store. ADR-0011 rule 4 lists the IdP, SMTP, connectors and the AI endpoint, not the object store. That is documentation drift with no behavioural effect, so I record it as an observation, not a finding.

summary: FAIL on candidate 4b84bf20 (source 654e39d). I had no open findings (verifications: []). BE-Z4 is correct for the corrective case, transition decision and performance-area link. FE-Z2 reveals nothing new. But a sensitive benefit itself is not hidden from a workstream member without the grant. getTraceability and getMissingLinks return its id, code and title. The G6 readiness names it. The live registers report and a report snapshot that any reader with report.generate can store return its title and planned value, to TL and AUD. That bypasses D-199's export refusal, because export is the only path checked. F-DG6-300: High, mandatory, REQ-S10-002; BE-B2's handback had left traceability, impact and missing links 'not done'. F-DG6-301: Low, three untranslated field-error codes and a catalogue-test blind spot. Everything else passes: static checks, historical validators DG1-DG5, unit tests on Node 22 and 24 (exit 1 only from vitest's own RPC timeout under load; the re-runs alone exit 0), integration 417/417 files in both locales (4217 passed, 1 skipped, 1 todo, declared), the deferred e2e 28/28, and the AUD and ADM-only sweeps. The shared volume filled up during my run, so several shard attempts are void; all are kept and disclosed in CS-07.
